item.title: Open WebUI: Self-Hosted ChatGPT Alternative for Local LLMs
item.description: Open WebUI brings the ChatGPT experience onto your own infrastructure: Ollama plus any OpenAI-compatible backend behind a modern chat UI with RAG document chat, multi-user auth, voice, prompt tooling, and model management. Privacy-first, offline-capable, and scalable from laptop Docker runs to Kubernetes fleets.
